sentences.text: Notices to Mariners keep your charts and publications current.
The Local Notice to Mariners is published weekly by each Coast Guard district.
It covers aids that have been added, moved or are off station, dredging and construction, marine events, hazards, and chart corrections for local waters.
The National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency publishes a weekly Notice to Mariners for ocean charts and international publications.
For urgent information, the Coast Guard makes Broadcast Notices to Mariners, announced on VHF channel sixteen and then read on channel twenty-two alpha.
